Late Roman cu-alloy an issue of Licinius from the mint at Nicomedia (RIC 7 (Nicomedia), 44 of AD 321-4). The obverse reads, with radiate head right, IMP C VAL LICIN LICINIVS P F AVG; the reverse legend is IOVI CONSERVATORI, with Jupiter standing left, chlamys over left shoulder, leaning on a sceptre with eagle.
